source: Z:/…/2026 2학기 학교 프린트 모음/기말/영덕중2/ 의 L7 학습지 16쪽 중 1쪽 «Vocabulary» 30낱말 · 2쪽 A·B·C · 3쪽 «Challenging» A·B · 15쪽 단어표 19낱말
source_note: 스캔 + 학생 손글씨. 인쇄된 것만 옮겼다. 1쪽은 01~30 영어 · 31~60 우리말 뜻(같은 30낱말, 순서 섞임) — ko 는 그 인쇄된 뜻을 낱말에 짝지은 것이다. 15쪽은 쪽 · 번호 · 단어 · 한글 뜻 · 영영풀이 · 예문 · 해석 표(가로 인쇄)로 청명중2 New Words 19 와 낱말 · 풀이 · 예문이 같다 — 확대해 한 번 더 읽고 청명 JSON 글자를 옮겼다. 영영풀이가 세 벌이다: def_en 은 15쪽 단어표, 2쪽 · 3쪽의 다른 풀이와 예문은 alt 에 남겼다 (드릴 도구는 def_en 만 쓴다). cemetery 는 3쪽 보기에만 나오고 뜻 칸이 비어 있다. 2쪽 B 보기의 'alter' 는 인쇄 그대로다 (altar 가 아님, 정답으로 쓰이지 않는다). 원장 확인 대상.
why_best: 학교 지정 30낱말에 뜻이 전부 인쇄돼 있고, 그중 18개 + puzzle 에 학교 영영풀이 · 예문 · 해석이 있다.

words.def_en: a type of table used in ceremonies
words.example_en: The altar was beautifully decorated for the wedding.

words.def_en: to destroy, damage, injure or kill somebody or something by fire
words.example_en: Lisa burned her old letters.

words.def_en: to show that a day or an event is important by doing something special
words.example_en: We will celebrate her birthday with a big party.
words.example_ko: 우리는 큰 파티로 그녀의 생일을 축하할 것이다.

alt.example_en: We held a party to celebrate the New Year.

words.def_en: the clothes worn by actors in a play or film, or worn by somebody to make them look like somebody or something else
words.example_en: I will wear a prince costume for the Halloween party.
words.example_ko: 나는 할로윈 파티를 위해 왕자 복장을 입을 것이다.

alt.def_en: special clothes for a show, party, etc. to look different
alt.example_en: The boy wore a special costume for the Halloween party.

alt.def_en: special clothes that people wear to look like someone or something else

words.def_en: to make something look more attractive by putting things on it
words.example_en: Mom decorated the living room with flowers.

alt.def_en: to make something look nicer by putting things on it
alt.example_en: He is going to decorate the Christmas tree tonight.

words.def_en: the pattern of colorful explosions in the air planned as a show
words.example_en: What time do the fireworks start?
The giant tree stands in the middle of the park.
words.example_ko: 거대한 나무가 공원 한가운데에 서 있다.

alt.def_en: very big or larger than usual
alt.example_en: We watched a movie about a giant robot.

words.example_en: The safety of the workers really matters to the company.

alt.example_en: For them, time doesn't matter so much.

words.def_en: a line of people or vehicles moving together through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event
words.example_en: The children waved their hands when the parade went by their house.
words.example_ko: 아이들은 퍼레이드가 그들의 집을 지나갈 때 손을 흔들었다.

words.def_en: to take part in or become involved in an activity
words.example_en: Did you decide to participate in the dance contest?

alt.def_en: to take part in an activity
alt.example_en: I'm going to participate in the science fair with Ms. Brown.

alt.def_en: to join in an activity or event with others

words.def_en: a long, thin stick of wood or metal that is often used to support something
words.example_en: We used a pole to get the ball from the tree.
words.example_ko: 우리는 나무에서 공을 꺼내기 위해 막대기를 사용했다.

alt.def_en: a long, thin stick of wood, metal, etc.
alt.example_en: We used a pole to raise the flag during the ceremony.

words.def_en: able to be done or achieved
words.example_en: There are some possible solutions to the problem.
words.example_ko: 그 문제에 대한 몇 가지 가능한 해결책이 있다.

alt.example_en: There are several possible answers to the question.

words.example_en: She followed the recipe carefully to make the soup.
words.example_ko: 그녀는 수프를 만들기 위해 그 요리법을 신중하게 따랐다.

words.def_en: a type of deer that lives in the northern parts of Europe, Asia, and North America
words.example_en: Santa's reindeer are famous for their names like Rudolph.
words.example_ko: 산타의 순록은 루돌프와 같은 이름으로 유명하다.

words.def_en: the structure of bones that support the body of a person or an animal
words.example_en: I saw the skeleton of a dinosaur in the museum.

alt.def_en: the bones of a body, or something made to look like bones

words.def_en: a large art object of a person or an animal that is made from a hard material like stone or metal
words.example_en: Many people visit the city to see the famous statue.
words.example_ko: 많은 사람들이 유명한 조각상을 보기 위해 그 도시를 방문한다.

words.example_en: Red roses often symbolize love.
The baby cried all night long. I couldn't sleep at all.
There are hundreds of books in the library.
The concert will take place in a big stadium.
words.example_ko: 그 콘서트는 큰 경기장에서 열릴 것이다.

extra_words._note: 1쪽 30낱말 밖이지만 학습지에 나온 말. puzzle 은 15쪽 단어표, cemetery 는 3쪽 영영풀이 보기.

items.def_en: a game or problem that you have to think about carefully to solve
